## C3 · Project Synthesis (one record per project, what the experts audit)
Called with a project id after its sources change (new source linked, source moved, projects merged). **Merge Sources** unites the extractions of all its sources by rules: every outcome, reach, cost and place keeps the source it came from (S12), the strongest stage and evidence are taken, dates span all sources. When the project has several analysed sources, **Write Project Summary** (GPT-6 Luna) reconciles them: summary, what the evidence shows, where sources agree or disagree, what is missing. Saved in `ai_projects.synthesis`.

parameters.query:
SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.code, p.name, p.aliases, p.implementing_org, p.countries,
       s.id AS source_id, s.url, s.title, s.title_en, s.doi, s.source_type, s.country, s.language, s.text_chars, s.text_level,
       sp.method, sp.reason, e.id AS extraction_id, e.fields, e.flags, e.relevance_score
FROM ai_projects p
JOIN source_projects sp ON sp.project_id = p.id
JOIN sources s ON s.id = sp.source_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM extractions x WHERE x.source_id = s.id ORDER BY x.created_at DESC LIMIT 1) e ON true
WHERE p.id = NULLIF($1, '')::bigint
ORDER BY s.id

UPDATE ai_projects SET synthesis = $2::jsonb, implementing_org = COALESCE(NULLIF($3, ''), implementing_org),
       countries = CASE WHEN jsonb_array_length($4::jsonb) > 0 THEN $4::jsonb ELSE countries END, updated_at = now()
WHERE id = $1 RETURNING id AS project_id, code
